audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1 and 3 disagree with the published mirror (both layers read Skill, Heimerdinger, ..., Skill where the mirror has Warwick, Skill, ..., Heimerdinger).
audit.why: The mirror audit (heimerdinger__warwick) set Level 1 Warwick, Level 2 Skill, Level 3 Heimerdinger, Levels 4-5 Heimerdinger, Level 6 Skill, First item Heimerdinger, 2+ items Heimerdinger. This side's packet agrees with it on rows 0, 1, 3, 5 and 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 3 flipped on both layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled, and whys[2] rewritten so the prose agrees. diff HARD and 8.5/10 kept — a 43.31% win rate supports them.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the level-6 stage was framed as Warwick's window.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank — it never gets shorter, which makes the gap after he throws it a fixed, countable engage window. Hextech Micro-Rockets is 11/10/9/8/7s and H-28 G Evolution Turret is a 1s cooldown at 20 mana, which is why the field rebuilds faster than you can clear it.
audit.corrected: The flat 11s is now the anchor in spikes[1], mid, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.trading.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] says to 'R-lock Heimerdinger to ignore his CH-2 Electron Grenade (E) stun', and wants.you[1] says to 'R-lock through the E stun'. Both are backwards.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is flagged channel: interruptible, and the grenade is hard CC — his stun cancels your ultimate rather than being ignored by it. The mirror agent found the same class of error on Heimerdinger's page (it claimed Duress 'does not leap over your turrets' when Riot's text makes it a leap whose distance scales with bonus Move Speed). A player trusting the current line ults into the stun and dies.
audit.corrected: Reversed in spikes[1], wants.you[1], mid, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d, and the leap/Move Speed relationship stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade is written as 'CH-2 Grenade' and 'CH-2 Electron Grenade' throughout.
audit.why: Riot's name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. The mirror also reports a fabricated 'CH-3X' grenade appearing on other Heimerdinger pages — not present here, but the truncation is the same family of error.
audit.corrected: Full name used in every string rewritten. The remaining short forms sit in focus.text and loading, which are keyed to a tracked-ability label and were left alone rather than desynced from the applier's focus wiring.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood told you to hold Q to follow his dash. Heimerdinger has no dash.
audit.why: His only mobility is Hextech Affinity, Move Speed near allied towers and his own turrets — which means the trade rule is the opposite: punish him when he steps away from that field.
audit.corrected: tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading and report[3] rewritten around the turret line.

edits.before: At 3 you can still Blood Hunt in and trade before turrets stack.
edits.after: Level 3 is his — H-28 G turrets cost 20 mana on a 1s cooldown.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is your one real answer: R-lock Heimerdinger to ignore his CH-2 Electron Grenade (E) stun and drag him off his turret nest, all-inning the instant his E is on cooldown before he can stack turrets on your face.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a channel, so his stun cancels it outright — CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank, and those 11 seconds are your whole window. Make him throw it first, then leap; the leap goes further with Blood Hunt speed.

edits.before: By level 4 Heimer's stacked turrets and rockets out-zone you, and though your level 6 Infinite Duress can pick him off his nest when his E is down, mistime it into the stun and his turret wall shreds you before your team arrives.
edits.after: By level 4 his stacked turrets and rockets out-zone you. Infinite Duress can still pick him off the nest, but it is a channel — the grenade cancels it, so count the flat 11 seconds and leap inside that gap, with Primal Howl held for the turrets.

edits.before: R-lock through the E stun to drag him off his nest
edits.after: Ult only once the grenade stun has been spent

edits.before: Your passive sustain wins extended level-1 auto wars. Identify how Heimerdinger contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger heals you below 50% health and triples below 25%, and at level 1 he has one turret and no grenade — this is your best stage.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a leap that travels further with bonus Move Speed — but the grenade's stun cancels the channel, so this level is only even, not yours.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: a flat 11s at every rank, and its stun cancels your ult — that gap is your only engage window. - Hextech Micro-Rockets: 11s at rank 1. - Infinite Duress: 110s — kill windows only.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His self-peel stun, and it cancels your ult — engage inside the 11s gap.

edits.after: Q-bite Heimerdinger the moment he steps past his own turret line, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal the chip.

notes: Highest-value correction in the slice so far: the page told the reader to ult THROUGH the grenade stun in two places. Infinite Duress is a channel and the grenade is hard CC, so it cancels the ultimate — following that advice loses the fight every time. The flat 11-second grenade cooldown (identical at all five ranks) is the concrete number the whole matchup can be played off, and it was nowhere on the page.
